text_block_list.text:
Найс Нэйчер gets a decent result in the

Wakagoma Stakes.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
However, when she sees how Токай Тэйо
has
captivated the crowd with her
brilliant
performance, she becomes
discouraged.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I suggest a trip to enter a local race, the
Kokura
Kinen, to give her more
confidence.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
